sql: select 'orders' as metric, strategy as label, count(*) as n, min(created_at)::text as first_at, max(created_at)::text as last_at from live_orders where strategy in ('Fmmsell10','Hmmsell10') and created_at>='2026-09-16T00:00:00Z' and action='buy' and side='no' group by strategy union all select 'estimated_rows',relname,reltuples::bigint,null,null from pg_class where relname in ('execution_book_events','execution_trade_events','execution_fill_events','live_order_queue_ticks','live_paper_parity_events') union all select 'feature_keys',k, count(*),null,null from (select features_json from live_order_queue_ticks where features_json is not null order by id desc limit 10) t cross join lateral jsonb_object_keys(t.features_json::jsonb) k group by k
